label: Coordinated launch plan JSA calibration
jsaText:
1
Define a coordinated launch plan
7.2.1
8
As a Program Coordinator, I need to create one coordinated launch plan that can include research tasks, vendor reviews, prototype builds, training sessions, materials, and effort estimates so that launch work can be planned from one place.
GIVEN a launch initiative includes research tasks, vendor reviews, prototype builds, and training sessions WHEN the launch plan is created THEN each applicable activity is represented as planned scope within the coordinated plan.
GIVEN a named activity is not needed for a specific launch WHEN plan scope is reviewed THEN the inapplicable activity can be omitted without blocking the remaining launch plan.
2
Specify resources and effort for planned work
7.2.2
5
As a Program Coordinator, I need to capture materials, effort estimates, owners, and readiness details for planned activities so that downstream outputs can use the right planning context.
GIVEN a planned launch activity has material or effort needs WHEN activity details are specified THEN the materials and effort estimates remain tied to the activity that requires them.
GIVEN a planned activity is missing resource details WHEN approval packet or handoff readiness is reviewed THEN the missing materials, effort, or ownership details are visible before dependent work proceeds.
3
Coordinate sequencing and readiness
7.2.3
5
As a Program Coordinator, I need dependent launch activities and handoffs to respect sequence and readiness rules so that later work does not proceed from incomplete prerequisites.
GIVEN a plan contains dependent activities WHEN a prerequisite activity is incomplete THEN the dependent activity is treated as not ready for downstream work.
GIVEN a planned sequence conflicts with a required order WHEN readiness is reviewed THEN the sequence conflict is visible before outputs or handoffs proceed.
4
Prepare approval packets from planned scope
7.1.4
5
As a Finance Analyst, I need approval packets to reflect the planned materials and effort estimates so that reviewers can decide based on the proposed launch scope.
GIVEN a launch plan contains materials and effort estimates WHEN an approval packet is prepared THEN the packet reflects the planned items and the estimates that affect the decision.
GIVEN a launch plan contains items that should not affect approval WHEN the approval packet is prepared THEN the packet includes only the applicable decision scope while other planned work remains in the plan.
5
Create downstream handoffs from eligible planned items
7.2.4
8
As a Program Coordinator, I need follow-up purchase orders or onboarding tasks to be derived from eligible planned items so that downstream work traces back to the coordinated plan.
GIVEN a ready plan contains items eligible for purchasing WHEN downstream handoffs are initiated THEN purchase order handoffs are created from eligible planned items and remain tied to the source plan.
GIVEN a ready plan contains onboarding work WHEN downstream handoffs are initiated THEN onboarding tasks are created from eligible planned items and remain tied to the source plan.
GIVEN a planned item has unresolved details WHEN downstream handoffs are initiated THEN no purchase order or onboarding task is created for that item until the missing details are resolved.

label: Support triage JSA calibration
jsaText:
1
Classify incoming support requests
4.1.1
5
As a Support Coordinator, I need incoming support requests classified by priority so that urgent work is recognized quickly.
GIVEN a support request is received WHEN its business impact is assessed THEN the request has a priority classification.
2
Route support requests to the right team
4.1.2
5
As a Support Coordinator, I need support requests routed to the responsible team so that work reaches the group that can resolve it.
GIVEN a support request has a priority and topic WHEN routing occurs THEN the responsible team is identified.
3
Track triage status
4.1.3
3
As a Support Coordinator, I need triage status visibility so that pending and routed work can be monitored.
GIVEN a support request has been triaged WHEN its routing or priority changes THEN the triage status reflects the current state.
